children: ACT Energy Technologies Ltd. (T.ACX) Hit a 52-Week High of $7.80. ACT Energy announced that the Toronto Stock Exchange has accepted and provided approval for ACT's notice of intention to renew our normal course issuer bid. The NCIB allows ACT to purchase up to 2,480,111 common shares (representing 10% of the Company's public float, as defined by the TSX, as of July 30, 2026) over a period of 12 months commencing on August 14, 2026.
Alvopetro Energy Ltd. (V.ALV) Hit a 52-Week High of $10.70. Alvopetro announced that it has completed drilling the 183-H2 well at its 100%-owned Murucututu natural gas field in Brazil.

BCM Resources Corp (V.B) Hit a 52-Week High of 78 cents. BCM announced that an aggressive geophysical survey at its Thompson Knolls porphyry-skarn discovery is currently underway. The contractor, Zonge International, Inc., based in Reno, Nevada, initiated systematic ground-induced polarization and magnetotellurics surveys.

Cascadia Minerals Ltd (V.CAM) Hit a 52-Week High of 37 cents. Cascadia announced drill results form its Carmacks Gold project in Yukon. Hole CD-26-056 at Zone 2000S returned: 82.69 m of 1.12% copper with 0.64 g/t gold (1.78% CuEq), including 49.16 m of 1.63% copper with 0.95 g/t gold (2.62% CuEq).

Carlin Gold Corporation (V.CGD) Hit a 52-Week High of $1.35. This week, Carlin reports the following changes to management, effective September 1. Dong Shim has been appointed Chief Financial Officer and Marla Ritchie, has been appointed Corporate Secretary. Mr. Aris Morfopoulos is resigning as Chief Financial Officer and Corporate Secretary effective August 31 to pursue other opportunities.

Glacier Media Inc. (T.GVC) Hit a 52-Week High of 37 cents. Glacier reported consolidated revenue for the period ended June 30, 2026, was $30.2 million, a decrease of $2.4 million or 7.3%. Consolidated EBITDA for the period was $1.4 million, an increase of $1.8 million, from an EBITDA loss of $0.4 million for the same period in the prior year.

Hammond Manufacturing Company Ltd (T.HMM.A) Hit a 52-Week High of $24.45. In July, the U.S. administration announced new tariffs of 50% on certain Canadian products imported into the U.S. under Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, effective August 19. Following a brief three-day pause, the tariffs officially came into force on August 22.

Logan Energy Corp. (V.LGN) Hit a 52-Week High of $1.17. Logan reported second-quarter Adjusted Funds Flow increased to $47.8 million ($0.07 per share, diluted) for the three months ended June 30, 2026, an increase of 76% from $27.2 million ($0.04 per share, diluted) reported in the comparative three-month period of 2025.

Orvana Minerals Corp (T.ORV) Hit a 52-Week High of $2.80. In mid-August Orvava provided updates on the Oxides Stockpile Project at its Don Mario operation in Bolivia, and reports results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026

Scorpio Gold Corporation (V.SGN) Hit a 52-Week High of 35.5 cents. Scorpio announced results from four drill-holes of the Phase Two drill program at the Manhattan District Project, Nevada, USA: 26MN-113, 26MN-115, 26MN-116, and 26MN-118.

Storm Exploration Inc. (V.STRM) Hit a 52-Week High of 51 cents. Storm announced that, due to increased investor demand, it has increased the size of its previously announced non-brokered private placement from aggregate gross proceeds of up to $2,000,000 to aggregate gross proceeds of up to $2,700,000.

ZTEST Electronics Inc. (C.ZTE) Hit a 52-Week High of 46.5 cents. Last week, ZTEST has granted incentive stock options to purchase an aggregate of 1,200,000 common shares of the Company to Company's President and Chief Executive Officer, and to each of the Company's four other directors, in accordance with the terms of the Company's stock option plan and subject to the policies of the Canadian Securities Exchange.

title: ACT, ZTEST, Alvopetro at 52-Week Highs on News
